description: This file defines function prototypes and inline functions for handling filesystem paths, including resolving absolute paths, concatenating prefixes with paths, and checking for absolute path formats. It appears to be part of a larger project related to filesystem path operations.

methods.name: is_directory
methods.description: Checks if the given path is a directory.

methods.name: strbuf_realpath
methods.description: Resolves the real path of a given path, stored in a strbuf.

methods.name: strbuf_realpath_forgiving
methods.description: Resolves the real path forgiving errors, stored in a strbuf.

methods.name: real_pathdup
methods.description: Duplicates the real path of a given path.

methods.name: absolute_path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the given path.

methods.name: absolute_pathdup
methods.description: Duplicates the absolute path of the given path.

methods.name: prefix_filename
methods.description: Concatenates prefix and path with no separator.

methods.name: prefix_filename_except_for_dash
methods.description: Concatenates prefix and path; returns '-' if path is '-'.

methods.name: int is_absolute_path(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute (by prefix or drive letter).

methods.name: strbuf_add_absolute_path
methods.description: Adds an absolute path to a strbuf, converting relative paths.

methods.name: strbuf_add_real_path
methods.description: Canonizes a path and appends it to a strbuf, resolving symlinks.
